known_good_rollback.reason: User directly confirmed v0.4.2 rendered fully and correctly.

architecture: v0.4.4 single-owner core renderer plus v0.4.5 targeted enhancement for interpretation/full-cycle/intraday/turning-points

score_semantics.rule: Do not show bare internal scores when interpretation is practical; pair with /100 and a plain-language band.

risk_copy.preferred: Explain the condition and reason, e.g. avoid chasing or abrupt size increases after a sharp drop and wait for trend/relative-strength recovery before scaling in.

cycle.visual_paths: current + 8 largest declines + 8 largest rallies per asset, max 60 points each
cycle.historical_cycle_reconstruction: pair chronological confirmed 상승 swing with following 하락 swing using real dates/trading-days/move_pct metadata
cycle.forecast_rule: historical comparison only; never present mean/median or cycle position as a guaranteed future turning date

intraday.primary_view: Nasdaq/S&P500/Dow verified intraday percent changes with explicit % axis and 0% direction
intraday.secondary_actual_chart: QQQ actual daily TradingView remains available under details
intraday.removed_as_primary: ambiguous market buy-timing line mixed with unlabeled QQQ price line

turning_points.similarity: QQQ same-direction historical segments ranked by duration and magnitude similarity

browser_qa.viewport_contract: Use browser.newPage({viewport:{width,height}}); viewportSize is invalid for Browser.newPage and previously caused false mobile QA.

android_back_contract: modal open -> hardware Back closes modal
hourly_automation_rule: Update market JSON only; never rewrite HTML/JS/CSS/VERSION/cycle-history.json. Keep prose compact and risk language conditional rather than commanding.
apk_done_definition: Real desktop/mobile Browser QA success -> Android Actions success -> Artifact exists -> APK downloaded and integrity checked -> provide file directly to user
